name: wait_for_background_music_reload

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_WaitForBackgroundMusicReload takes no Script context and returns scheduler state 4 while asynchronous-load bit 57 in D_00388550 is set, otherwise state 2, without accessing the value stack

notes: Command 252 reload_background_music starts the amusic/music%03d.dat transfer and its completion callback clears the polled asynchronous-load bit. Every one of the nine JP calls immediately follows command 252.
